summary: Amazon has begun dismissing employees who have publicly criticized the company's business ties with the Israeli government, citing breaches of company policy. title: Microsoft is ending support for Windows 10. Here's what you need to know
summary: Microsoft has ended automatic security updates and support for Windows 10, impacting millions of PC users. While newer computers can upgrade to Windows 11, older ones have options like paying for extended security updates, utilizing a free Microsoft option with OneDrive, or switching to alternative operating systems such as Chrome Flex or Linux Mint. Users should be aware of potential costs for extended support or incompatibility issues with other operating systems.

title: Beyond Meat dealt another blow in latest bad news for plant-based company
summary: Beyond Meat's stock plunged by 12% in Tuesday trading after the company announced a debt exchange plan that will dilute the value of current shares. The plant-based meat maker, once a market darling, has struggled with poor sales in the U.S. and recently suspended operations in China, despite some success in Europe. CEO Ethan Brown indicated a strategic shift towards a broader "Beyond" brand and different protein offerings.

title: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink: Asset Tokenization Is Just Beginning — 2025 RWA and Ethereum (ETH) Trading Implications - Blockchain News
summary: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink announced that the market is at the beginning of the tokenization of all assets, signaling a continued institutional focus on real-world asset (RWA) adoption on blockchain. This move could democratize investments, allowing retail traders to access high-value assets, and opens up significant trading opportunities in tokenized assets and related cryptocurrencies like Ethereum (ETH), Chainlink (LINK), and Polygon (MATIC). The article suggests that increased institutional adoption could bolster the overall crypto ecosystem and influence price dynamics across major tokens, leading to potential bullish breakouts.

title: Microsoft Bullied OpenAI Into Cloud Deal, Antitrust Suit Says - Law360
summary: A proposed class action lawsuit has been filed against Microsoft Corp. by ChatGPT subscribers, alleging the company inflated prices by forcing OpenAI into an exclusive cloud computing deal. The suit claims Microsoft wielded its significant investment in OpenAI to gain sole provider status for computing services for OpenAI's AI products. This action took place in a California federal court, with the suit filed on Monday.

title: Banjo-Kazooie director Gregg Mayles confirms he's left Rare - Engadget
summary: Gregg Mayles, the director of Sea of Thieves and designer on Donkey Kong Country, announced his departure from Rare after a 36-year tenure, following recent layoffs and game cancellations across Xbox Game Studios. Mayles was instrumental in creating Banjo-Kazooie and served as Rare's creative director. His exit highlights Microsoft's challenging transition with its Xbox business strategy.

title: Microsoft Drops Terrifyingly Large October Patch Update
summary: Microsoft's October 2025 Patch Tuesday is its largest on record, encompassing 175 CVEs, including two actively exploited zero-days and several high-severity privilege escalation bugs. The update also marks the end of life for Windows 10 regular patches, urging organizations to consider Extended Security Updates. This massive security release highlights a significant increase in vulnerabilities patched by Microsoft this year compared to the previous year.

title: Siemens Treasury: leading innovation in real-time payments - flow – Deutsche Bank
summary: Heiko Nix, Siemens' Global Head of Cash Management and Payments, discusses the ongoing transformation of Siemens' Corporate Treasury, driven by technology and a four-pillar strategy: simplification, automation, acceleration, and innovation. This innovative approach has led to significant efficiencies, including 24/7 liquidity management and increased automation across global operations.

title: Microsoft unveils MAI-Image-1, its first AI model that turns words into pictures - The Eastleigh Voice
summary: Microsoft unveiled MAI-Image-1, its first proprietary text-to-image AI model, marking a significant shift in its AI strategy from primarily distributing other models to becoming a creator. Developed with input from professional artists, MAI-Image-1 aims to produce high-quality, realistic images faster and with fewer computing resources, featuring natural-language understanding for conversational prompt interaction.

title: Salesforce opens the age of ‘Agentic Enterprise’ amid fastest innovation cycle in its history - Marketing-Interactive
summary: Salesforce has launched Agentforce 360, a platform designed to bridge the "agentic divide" by connecting human employees with AI agents to enhance business systems and accelerate innovation. summary: Beyond Meat's shares dropped below $1 after the company announced a plan to reduce its debt by $800 million through debt exchange and issuing up to 326 million new shares. summary: Jamie Dimon, CEO of JPMorgan Chase, discussed the transformative power of AI while cautioning that some asset prices are in "bubble territory." summary: Thomas Gaffney, COO of OFA Group (NASDAQ: OFAL), discusses how their AI platform PlanAid is revolutionizing building code compliance by automating the review of architectural blueprints against local and national codes. title: Microsoft clears up what Windows 10 users can expect from Microsoft Defender moving forward - XDA
summary: Microsoft has clarified that Microsoft Defender will continue to support Windows 10, even as non-security support for the operating system ends. Users enrolled in the Extended Security Updates (ESU) program will receive security updates, and Defender will maintain detection and protection, with security intelligence updates guaranteed through October 2028.
